items.name: Cubing in the Cape Q1 2026
items.information:
Welcome to Cubing in the Cape Q1 2026!

This is a single day competition with a handful of popular events, as well as the first **Best of 5 Round** for 3x3 Blindfolded featured in Cape Town.
